title: Leveraged ETFs, TLT Flows, Boomer Cavities | ETF IQ 9/14/2026
description:
"Bloomberg ETF IQ" focuses on the opportunities, risks and current trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the global exchange traded funds industry. Today's guests: Novadius Wealth Management President Nate Geraci, SGH Wealth Management Founder & CIO Sam Huszczo, Irrational Capital Founder & Partner David van Adelsberg, and TEMA ETFs Head of Investment Strategy Paisley Nardini.
